subject: MATHEMATICS
applicability_conditions: learner must produce a line equation from a direction plus an anchoring point
use when a remembered equation form is written before the given data is interpreted
anchor: A line equation is a membership test: a point lies on the line exactly when its coordinates satisfy the relation built from one known point and the constant direction.
ordinary_language_bridge: Ask 'from this known point, what must be true of any other point on the same line?' before choosing a formula.
reconstruction_route: mark the given point or points and name their coordinate roles
obtain the direction as a ratio of matched coordinate differences
write that the same ratio holds between a general point and the known point
clear the fraction to obtain a linear relation
rearrange to the requested form without changing the solution set
test the original point in the final equation

minimal_contrast.shared_structure: the same known point and the same numerical direction
minimal_contrast.focal_distinction: an equation that the known point satisfies versus one that it does not
minimal_contrast.prediction_prompt: Substitute the given point: does the equation stay true?
minimal_contrast.decisive_feature: membership of the anchoring point is the decisive check, not the shape of the written form

misconception_discriminator.candidate_wrong_model: a line equation is a template whose letters are filled from whichever numbers appear
misconception_discriminator.probe: give a point and a direction in a non-standard order and ask for the equation plus a check
misconception_discriminator.decisive_response: learner substitutes the given point and rejects a form that fails the check

repair_route: re-derive the direction from matched differences
rewrite the membership condition for a general point
clear denominators one step at a time
retry on a two-point case and on a slope-point case
verification_method: substitute each given point into the final equation and confirm equality
recover the direction from the final equation and compare with the given direction
known_limitations: does not handle vertical lines through the ratio route without a separate case
does not establish that supplied points are correct
